slots.name: UFC 6 Parsectagon Overlay
slots.description: Controller-friendly cheats, screenshots, Photo Mode, settings, and restart/quit actions on compatible UFC 6 engines.
slots.note: Choose a PORTHEON or Kyty UFC 6 engine folder when prompted.
slots.instructions: Choose PORTHEON's games\UFC6 launcher folder or the Kyty UFC 6 engine folder containing UFC 6.exe. The overlay setup checks the engine and only installs when compatible. This is separate from the extracted game-data folder. Button icons can also be changed later in the overlay.
slots.folderPrompt: Choose PORTHEON's games\UFC6 folder or your Kyty UFC 6 engine folder

slots.name: PORTHEON
slots.description: A free launcher for UFC 1–6 and other PC ports. It finds your games and chooses settings for your PC.
slots.note: Already have it? Use Play now after installing the game.
slots.instructions: Run the setup and follow its prompts. Open PORTHEON, choose UFC 6, and point Game files to your installed UFC 6 folder if it is not found automatically.
